canonical_statement: The study aimed to identify the prevalence, levels, predictors, and potential adverse outcomes of potential drug-drug interactions among cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Therefore, the study aimed to identify the prevalence, levels, predictors and potential adverse outcome of pDDIs among cancer patients receiving chemotherapy.

canonical_statement: The investigators performed a cross-sectional study in two tertiary care hospitals in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan: Hayatabad Medical Complex and Northwest General Hospital and Research Center.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A cross-sectional study was performed in two tertiary care hospitals of Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan: Hayatabad Medical Complex (HMC) and Northwest General Hospital and Research Center (NWGH & RC).

canonical_statement: Patients of any age or gender with any cancer treated with intravenous and/or oral anticancer agents were eligible.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Patients of any age and either gender diagnosed with any type of cancer and treated with anticancer agents (either intravenous and/ or oral) were included in this study.

population.label: Eligible patients
inclusion_criteria: Treatment with intravenous and/or oral anticancer agents

canonical_statement: Patient profiles were excluded when required information was lacking.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Whereas, patient profiles were excluded if the required information were lacking.

population.label: Excluded profiles

canonical_statement: Medication profiles were screened for potential drug-drug interactions with Micromedex Drug-Reax, and detected interactions were categorized by severity and documentation level.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Micromedex Drug-Reax® (Truven Health Analytics, Greenwood Village, Colorado, USA) was used for the screening of patients’ medication profile for pDDIs. ... all detected interactions were categorized on the basis of severity-levels and documentation-levels.

canonical_statement: Logistic regression was used to assess associations between pDDI presence and candidate predictors; variables with significant univariate p-values entered multivariate analysis, and p≤0.05 was considered significant.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Logistic regression analysis was applied in order to identify association of pDDIs presence ... For variables with significant univariate p-values multivariate analysis was performed. In this study p-value of 0.05 or less was considered significant.
